candidates.name: Necrobiosis Lipoidica
support_spans: compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate in the superficial dermis
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of reddish brown hyperkeratotic papules and the biopsy findings of compact hyperkeratosis and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate are consistent with Necrobiosis Lipoidica, a condition often associated with diabetes mellitus.

candidates.name: Necrobiosis lipoidica
support_spans: A man in his 60s presented with a 10-year history of a slowly progressive, asymptomatic cutaneous eruption on his left leg.
Reddish brown hyperkeratotic papules 1 to 10 mm wide were present on the front and back of the left leg from knee to ankle.
Hematoxylin-eosin–stained lesional skin biopsy specimens revealing compact hyperkeratosis, epidermal atrophy, and bandlike lymphocyte infiltrate in the superficial dermis
candidates.why: The patient's history of diabetes mellitus and the description of the cutaneous eruption are consistent with necrobiosis lipoidica.
